items.title: 9.2 Lewis concept of acids and bases (acids aur bases ki Lewis pehchan) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.2, printed page 191, with Quick Check 9.1 (page 192) as self-checks.

blocks.text: 1923 mein G.N. Lewis ne acid aur base ki ek generalized (zyada aam) definition (tareef) di. Is mein acid aur base ki pehchan is baat se hoti hai ke woh electrons ka ek pair (jora) le sakte hain ya de sakte hain, aur is se coordinate covalent bond banta hai.

blocks.title: Lewis acid aur Lewis base
blocks.text: Lewis acid koi bhi species (molecule ya ion) hai jo electrons ka ek pair le sake (acceptor), aur Lewis base koi bhi species hai jo electrons ka ek pair de sake (donor).
Lewis acid-base reaction tab hota hai jab base apne electrons ka pair acid ko deta hai.

Neeche wale reaction mein do ammonia molecules (Lewis bases) mein se har ek apna electron pair positive (musbat) charge wale silver ion (Lewis acid) ko deta hai. Baen taraf charges ka sum (jama) +1 hai, is liye daen taraf bane acid-base adduct (jur kar bana hua molecule/ion) ka charge bhi +1 hona chahiye:

blocks.alt: 2 H-N(H)-H jis ke N par red lone pair hai, 'Lewis base', plus Ag+, 'Lewis acid', arrow ke baad bracket mein [H3N→Ag←NH3]+ jahan har N coordinate arrow se apna pair Ag ko deta hai, 'Acid base adduct'.
blocks.caption: Ammonia (Lewis base) ka silver ion (Lewis acid) se reaction (kitab ke page 191 par chhape scheme ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: NH₃ ke N par ek lone pair hai, jo red dikhaya gaya hai. Yeh pair Ag⁺ ko diya jata hai, is liye N se Ag ki taraf arrow hai (coordinate bond). Do NH₃ do pairs dete hain, aur charge +1 hi rehta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein adduct ke neeche “Alcid base adduct” chhapa hai; sahi lafz “Acid base adduct” hai.

Boron trifluoride (BF₃) mein boron atom ke valence shell mein sirf chhe (6) electrons hain. Boron ka octet incomplete (adhoora) hai, is liye woh electron pair le sakta hai. Is wajah se BF₃ bohat achha Lewis acid hai aur bohat se Lewis bases se react karta hai. Is reaction mein fluoride ion Lewis base hai jo apne lone pairs mein se ek pair deta hai:

blocks.alt: Fluoride ion jis par chaar lone pairs aur negative charge hai, 'Lewis base', plus BF3 jis mein B teen F se jura hai aur har F par teen lone pairs hain, 'Lewis acid', arrow ke baad bracket mein [BF4]- jahan ek F coordinate arrow (F→B) se B ko pair deta hai, 'Acid base adduct'.
blocks.caption: Fluoride ion (Lewis base) ka boron trifluoride (Lewis acid) se reaction (kitab ke page 191 par chhape scheme ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: BF₃ mein B ke paas sirf chhe electrons hain. F⁻ ke chaar pairs mein se ek pair B ko milta hai (F→B arrow), aur BF₄⁻ banta hai jis mein B ka octet poora ho jata hai; charge −1 hi rehta hai.
Baen taraf charges ka sum −1 hai, is liye daen taraf adduct ka charge bhi −1 hona chahiye.
a) Neeche ke reactions mein conjugate acid-base pairs pehchanein:

blocks.prompt: a) In chaar reactions mein conjugate acid-base pairs kaun se hain?
blocks.explanation: Har reaction mein jo proton deta hai woh acid hai aur proton dene ke baad us ka conjugate base banta hai. (i) HCN/CN⁻ aur H₂O/H₃O⁺. (ii) CH₃COOH/CH₃COO⁻ aur H₂O/H₃O⁺. (iii) H₂S/HS⁻ aur H₂O/H₃O⁺. (iv) HCl proton HCO₃⁻ ko deta hai: HCl/Cl⁻ aur HCO₃⁻/H₂CO₃ (HCO₃⁻ base hai, H₂CO₃ us ka conjugate acid).

blocks.prompt: b) SO₃ aur O²⁻, HCl aur H₂O, aur BF₃ aur NH₃ ke reactions mein Lewis acid aur Lewis base pehchanein, aur balanced equation likhein.
blocks.explanation: SO₃ + O²⁻ → SO₄²⁻: oxide ion S ko electron pair deta hai, is liye O²⁻ Lewis base aur SO₃ Lewis acid. HCl + H₂O → H₃O⁺ + Cl⁻: pani ke O ka lone pair H⁺ se jurta hai, is liye H₂O Lewis base aur HCl ka H⁺ Lewis acid. BF₃ + NH₃ → H₃N→BF₃: N ka lone pair B ka incomplete octet poora karta hai, is liye NH₃ Lewis base aur BF₃ Lewis acid.

items: Lewis (1923): acid = electron pair lene wala, base = electron pair dene wala; diya gaya pair coordinate covalent bond banata hai.
Ag⁺ + 2NH₃ → [H₃N→Ag←NH₃]⁺ (+1); BF₃ + F⁻ → BF₄⁻ (−1). Adduct ka charge reactants ke charges ka sum hai.
